title: Megurine Luka — Cool Beauty〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The virtual show from the other day is being made available online for a limited time!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? The event where all six VIRTUAL SINGERS appear?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They're rotating videos every day to showcase all six of them, and today is Luka's turn!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! That's why I called to you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
My name is Megurine Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope you've been enjoying yourself so far.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe, that's good.
I'll be singing from my heart today in order to reach yours.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sigh... Luka is just so lovely.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The songs she sings are usually like that, too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mature love songs, melodies that are calm and graceful...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And she's got the perfect voice for sexy and cool songs too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I also like how she dances in her faster songs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? She has fast songs?
What are they like?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure we can find something with a quick search... Ah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe we don't need to search after all. Listen...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is such a bright and happy song!
I feel like I'm seeing a new side of Luka!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You found this video but you seem so surprised by what's inside.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I only watched the beginning because I wanted to watch the rest together with you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I feel like singing now, too!
Ichi, let's go sing karaoke after school today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Today?
I don't have work so sure, why not.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! I'm gonna try out all the songs that Luka sang!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Moving on to the next song...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope everyone's still keeping up!
